text: Supabase - Composio Toolkit | Composio All Toolkits Supabase SUPABASE Latest version 20261116_00 Supabase is an open-source backend-as-a-service providing a Postgres database, authentication, storage, and real-time subscription APIs for building modern applications Copy page Authentication Details Composio-managed OAuth available OAuth2 API Key Frequently Asked Questions How do I set up custom OAuth credentials for Supabase? Use your own Supabase OAuth app when you want to limit what the connection can do or show your app's name on the consent screen. The default Composio OAuth app may be configured with broader permissions, so scope limits belong in your own app. Create the Supabase app Open your Supabase organization and go to Organization Settings . Click Add Application and fill in the form: Name : for example, Composio-Supabase . Website URL : your application's URL. Authorization Callback URL : https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add . It must exactly match the oauth_redirect_uri field in your Composio auth config. Grant only the read and write permissions your tools need, then click Create . Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the page Supabase opens next. Create the auth config in Composio In the Composio dashboard, go to Auth Configs , click Create Auth Config , and select Supabase . Set the authentication type to OAuth2 and choose Use your own developer credentials . Paste the Client ID and Client Secret , then click Create Supabase Auth Config . Click Connect Account . Keep the Supabase API URL at https://api.supabase.com unless you self-host Supabase. Check that the consent screen lists only the permissions you granted the app, click Authorize , and confirm the account shows as Active . See Custom auth configs for the general flow. Scopes The permissions you select in the Supabase app decide what the connection can access. Composio's auth config requests the all scope and can't narrow it further, so set the limits in Supabase. Use a personal access token instead Supabase also supports API key authentication. Choose API Key as the authentication type, then on Connect Account paste a personal access token that starts with sbp_ . Create one at Account → Access Tokens . Supabase shows it only once, so copy it right away.
